index.md.Cette notion immédiate permet de déclenc: This immediate notion makes it possible to trigger very specific actions
index.md.vous rentrez chez vous et vous n'avez pa: you go home and you have not deactivated the alarm, before activating the siren it may be good to broadcast a message reminding you to deactivate the alarm and if it is not done 1 minute later (delay d '' activation of 1 minute) to activate the siren

index.md.permet de rendre les zones indépendantes: makes the zones independent in terms of alerts
index.md.En temps normal si une zone est en alert: Normally if a zone is on alert the plugin will ignore the other zones
index.md.En séparant les zones il répetera les ac: By separating the zones it will repeat the actions for the other zones which would enter in alert
index.md.lors d'un déclenchement l'alarme complèt: when triggered, the full alarm is rearmed to prevent subsequent triggers (in normal times it will not rearm until there has been a scenario / human action to do so)
index.md.Ne pas faire les actions immédiates si l: Do not take immediate actions if the sensor has no delay
index.md.indique à l'alarme de ne pas faire les a: tells the alarm not to do immediate actions if the sensor does not have a trigger delay, the alarm will therefore only do the actions
index.md.Pour chaque action il est possible de sp: For each action it is possible to specify the mode in which it should be executed or in all modes
index.md.C'est ici que vous configurez les différ: This is where you configure the different zones and the actions (immediate and deferred by zone, note that it is also possible to configure them globally) to be done in the event of triggering.
index.md.Une zone peut aussi bien être volumétriq: An area can either be volumetric (for the day for example) or perimeter (for the night) or also areas of the house (garage, bedroom, outbuildings, etc.)
index.md.Un bouton en haut à droite vous permet d: A button at the top right allows you to add as many as you want
index.md.Il est possible d'éditer le nom de la zo: It is possible to edit the name of the zone by clicking on the name of the zone (in front of the label "Name of the zone")
index.md.Une zone est constituée de différents él: A zone is made up of different elements
index.md.Un déclencheur est une commande binaire,: A trigger is a binary command, which when set to 1 will trigger the alarm
index.md.Il est possible d'inverser le déclencheu: It is possible to reverse the trigger, so that it is the state 0 of the sensor which triggers the alarm, by putting "reverse" on YES
index.md.Une fois votre déclencheur choisi, vous: Once you have chosen your trigger, you can specify an activation delay in minutes (it is not possible to descend below the minute)
index.md.Ce délai permet par exemple, si vous act: This delay allows for example, if you activate the alarm before leaving home, not to trigger the alarm for a minute (time to let you out)
index.md.Autre cas, certains détecteurs de mouvem: In other cases, some motion detectors remain in triggered mode (value 1) for a certain time even if there is no detection, for example 4 minutes, so it is good to delay the activation of these sensors by 4 or 5 min so that the alarm does not go off immediately after activation
index.md.Ensuite vous avez le délai de déclenchem: Then you have the trigger delay, unlike the activation delay which only takes place once when the alarm is activated, it is set up after each trigger of a sensor
index.md.La cinématique est la suivante lors du d: The kinematics are as follows when the sensor is triggered (door opening, presence detection), if the activation times have passed, the alarm will trigger the immediate actions but will wait until the activation time is finished before trigger actions
index.md.Enfin vous avez le bouton \"inverser\" q: Finally you have the "reverse" button which allows you to reverse the triggering state of the sensor (0 instead of 1)
index.md.qui permet de spécifier un délai de main: which allows you to specify a trigger hold time before triggering the alarm
index.md.Ex si vous avez un détecteur de fumée qu: Ex if you have a smoke detector which sometimes raises false alarms you can specify a delay of 2s
index.md.Lors du déclenchement de l'alarme Jeedom: When the alarm is triggered Jeedom will wait 2s and check that the smoke detector is still on alert if it is not the case it will not trigger the alarm
index.md.) j'ai ici un délai d'activation de 5 mi: ) here I have an activation time of 5 minutes and a trigger time of 1 minute
index.md.Cela veut dire que lorsque j'active l'al: This means that when I activate the alarm, during the first 5 minutes no triggering of the alarm can take place because of this sensor
index.md.Passé ce délai de 5 minutes, si un mouve: After this delay of 5 minutes, if a movement is detected by the sensor, the alarm will wait 1 minute (the time to let me deactivate the alarm) before triggering the actions
index.md.Si j'avais eu des actions immédiates cel: If I had had immediate actions these would have been triggered immediately without waiting for the end of the activation period, the non-immediate actions would have taken place after (1 minute after the immediate actions)
index.md.Comme décrit plus haut, ce sont des acti: As described above, these are actions that are triggered upon triggering without taking into account the trigger delay (but still taking into account the activation delay)
index.md.Vous avez juste à sélectionner la comman: You just have to select the desired action command and then according to it fill the execution parameters
index.md.Lorsque plusieurs zones sont déclenchées: When several zones are triggered successively, only the immediate actions of the 1st zone triggered are executed
index.md.Les modes sont assez simples à configure: The modes are quite simple to configure, you just have to indicate the active zones according to the mode
index.md.Il est possible de renommer le mode en c: It is possible to rename the mode by clicking on its name (opposite the "Mode name" label)
index.md.Attention lors du renommage d'un mode il: Attention during the renaming of a mode it is absolutely necessary to review the scenarios / equipment which use the old name to pass them on the new
index.md.Lors du renommage d'un mode, il faut sur: When renaming a mode, you must on the alarm widget reclick on the mode in question for a full consideration (otherwise Jeedom remains on the old mode)
index.md.Il faut absolument créer au moins un mod: It is absolutely necessary to create at least one mode and assign zones to it otherwise your alarm will not work
index.md.Cette partie permet de définir les actio: This part defines the actions to be taken following an activation of the alarm.
index.md.Ici encore, vous retrouverez la notion i: Here again, you will find the immediate notion which represents the actions to be done immediately after arming the alarm, then come the activation actions which are executed after the triggering times
index.md.Dans l'exemple, ici j'allume par exemple: In the example, here I light a red lamp for example to indicate that the arming has been taken into account and I turn it off once the arming is complete (because normally there is no one left in the perimeter of the alarm, otherwise it triggers it)
index.md.Les actions d'activation OK ne prennent: Activation actions OK do not take into account activation times
index.md.Si vous avez un délai sur l'activation d: If you have a delay on the activation of an opening sensor, even if your door is open the activation actions will be executed
index.md.Ces actions sont exécutées si un capteur: These actions are executed if a sensor is triggered following the activation of the alarm or after the activation delay of a sensor if it is in alert
index.md.Vous pouvez aussi ici ajouter des action: Here you can also add actions when resuming a sensor monitoring
index.md.Permet de configurer les actions globale: Allows you to configure the global actions to be taken when an alarm is triggered
index.md.Vous n'êtes pas obligé d'en ajouter si v: You do not have to add more if you have configured specific actions by zone
index.md.Ces actions sont exécutées lorsque l'ala: These actions are executed when the alarm is deactivated and it is not triggered
index.md.Exemple vous rentrez chez vous, en ouvra: Example you go home, by opening the door it triggers the alarm, but you have set a trigger delay on the sensor and you cut the alarm before the end of the delay, the deactivation actions OK will be executed
index.md.Si par contre vous aviez arrêté l'alarme: If, on the other hand, you had stopped the alarm after the end of the triggering delay, this would not have been the case.
index.md.Cette partie vous permet de définir les: This part allows you to define the actions to be done when the alarm is triggered and then deactivated.
index.md.Ici aussi il y a des actions immédiates: Here too there are immediate and deferred actions
